subjects.description: Right humanoid black robotic arm with a dextrous multi-finger gripper, entering the frame from the right edge
subjects.appearance_details: Glossy black powder-coated armature with anthropomorphic articulation, a multi-fingered metallic gripper with visible knuckle joints and tendon-like cabling
subjects.relationship: Primary actor of the scene; picks the bok choy at its stem and places it into the pan
subjects.location: right edge of frame, hovering above the wooden table
subjects.orientation: Approaching from the right, gripper oriented down toward the base of the bok choy
subjects.pose: Extended over the workspace with the gripper aligned above the pale white stem at the base of the bok choy
subjects.action: extending, grasping the bok choy at its pale white base stem, lifting, translating left across the table directly over the frying pan, lowering down into the pan, releasing, retracting
subjects.state_changes: Gripper opens, descends to the bok choy and closes firmly around the pale white stem at the base. Arm lifts the bok choy cleanly off the table holding it by its base stem with the leaves splaying upward. Arm translates left across the table and positions the bok choy directly above the open frying pan. Arm lowers the bok choy down into the pan and the gripper opens, releasing the bok choy so it settles inside the pan with its base resting on the pan's interior surface and leaves splaying upward. Arm retracts up and to the right.

subjects.relationship: Object being manipulated by the right robotic arm; grasped at its white base stem
subjects.location: right half of the wooden table, to the right of the frying pan
subjects.orientation: Upright on its base, leaves splaying outward
subjects.action: being grasped at its pale white base stem, lifted upright with leaves splaying upward, carried left over the pan, lowered into the pan, and released to settle inside the pan
subjects.state_changes: The pale white stem at the base of the bok choy is gripped firmly. The bok choy is lifted vertically off the table while remaining upright, with its green leaves splaying upward as it is held by the stem. It is carried laterally to the left until it is directly above the frying pan. It is then lowered straight down into the pan and released. It settles inside the pan with its white base resting against the pan's interior surface and its green leaves splaying upward.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the wooden tabletop is shown with the frying pan on the left, the bok choy on the right, and both robotic arms at the edges of the frame. At 0:01 the right arm extends down toward the bok choy's white base stem. At 0:02 the gripper closes firmly around the pale white base stem. At 0:03 the right arm lifts the bok choy upright off the table, holding it by the stem with leaves splaying upward. At 0:04 the bok choy passes over the frying pan as the arm carries it left. At 0:05 the arm positions the bok choy directly above the pan's open interior. At 0:06 the arm lowers the bok choy down into the pan. At 0:07 the gripper opens and the bok choy is released inside the pan, settling onto the pan's cooking surface with its leaves splaying upward. At 0:08 the right arm has retracted toward the right edge of the frame and the bok choy rests inside the pan; the left arm has remained still throughout.
